newsitem.title: QATAR: Qatar shares remain largely unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Qatar shares remain largely unchanged.

text.p: Shares on Qatar's unofficial stock market ended the week to Thursday largely steady, brokers said.
Twelve shares remained unchanged, five rose and one dropped.
The Commercial Bank of Qatar's 18-share index crept up 0.13 points to 126.57 from 126.44 points the previous week.
Qatar General Insurance kept up its advance for the fifth week running, rising 10 riyals to 595 riyals and Qatar Islamic Bank rose seven riyals to 132.
Qatar Flour Mills gained two riyals to 315 and Doha Bank Ltd and Qatar Cement picked up a riyal each to 286 and 318 riyals respectively.
Qatar Navigation lost 10 riyals to 770 after sharp rises in December.
